language: "Urdu"

kalamType: "Noha"

Nalay kartay thay Sheh e Karb o bala wa waila
Bhai darya pe mera mara gaya wa waila

1
Aaj bin bhai ka may ho gaya is sehra may
Qatl bhai mera aada ne kiya wa waila

2
Jis ki khaatir meray bhai ne kataye baazo
Mashk woh chid gayi aur paani bahaa wa waila

3
Dhara e ahle haram quwwate bazo Abbas
Koi pardes may mera na raha wa waila

4
Foaj e Shabbir ka thanda hua raiti pe alam
Ho gaya khatama e foaj e Khuda wa waila

5
Kis ka matam karon noha parrhon kis ko royon
Haey ghurbat may huay sab hi juda wa waila

6
Le ke halqay may alam laash ke badlay Zainab
Bibi kar kar karo faryad o buka wa waila

7
Kon halmin ki sada sun ke bachaye ga mujhe
Qatl honay lagay Akbar bhi chala wa waila

8
Dilbar e Fatima ki jaisi tamanna thi Anees
Waisay hi kartay hain ye ahle aza wa waila

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/nale-krte-the-shhh-krb-o-bla-oaoila.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1].strip()
header, body = p.read_text().split('\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
assert roman == old
blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2] + [3] * 8
assert [block[0] for block in blocks[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸')
assert body.count('\\u200c') == body.count('بی\\u200cبی') == 1
print('Roman transcription preserved verbatim. Urdu opening and eight stanzas verified.')
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed all 18 verses in Urdu script, preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Verified that the opening and all eight stanzas match in structure.

The Roman “Dhara e” is ambiguous. I rendered it as “دھاراۓ” to preserve the recorded pronunciation.
